name: GEF Small Grants Programme Nepal
summary: Nepal's GEF Small Grants country programme, which channels grants to NGOs and community-based organisations for biodiversity and climate projects. The current call documents are only posted as downloads.

eligibility.rule: Addresses at least one GEF focal area and operational programme

applicant_types.quote: SGP channels financial and technical support directly to NGOs and CBOs for activities that conserve and restore the environment

geography.quote: The SGP in Nepal supports NGO/CBO projects in the GEF focal areas of biodiversity and climate change.

access.quote: SGP channels financial and technical support directly to NGOs and CBOs

administered_by.quote: Mailing Address UNDP/ The GEF Small Grants Programme UN House, Pulchowk Post Box 107, Kathmandu

co_finance_required.quote: All grantees will be required to mobilize cash and in-kind contributions.

eligibility.quote: Must address at least one GEF focal areas and operational programme
needs to be completed by June 2028

co_finance.quote: All grantees will be required to mobilize cash and in-kind contributions.

after_award.quote: Grantees will submit mid-term and final progress reports using standardized SGP formats
Each project will receive at least one monitoring visit during its lifecycle

documents.quote: institutional profile and registration certificates, documents verifying financial transaction done in the past, HR policy

effort.quote: should be submitted in electronic version (email attachment in MS Word programme readable by XP Professional) on the above-mentioned focal areas not later than 10 July 2026
The National Steering Committee of GEF SGP is responsible for reviewing and approving the project proposals.
